unknowns: Exact appointment date comes from university board minutes, not a paper date, personal age inference or a student start. Current source describes a part-time Apple research role alongside Penn; do not infer university leave or substitute a company internship.
PointAction’s video backbone is slow, and execution is open-loop. Self-occlusion and unexpected contact/slippage can cause failure; this is not a real-time closed-loop manipulation system.

The two arms were unseen during4D pretraining but each uses arm-specific demonstration post-training and a decoder trained from scratch. Do not describe real transfer as zero-shot without action supervision.
Gu and Lingjie Liu share the Penn project, and Mutian Tong is in Gu’s current lab roster. Shared physical20 is retained until independent apparatus/hosting access is established.
